contract.description: Generate a loadable file from blocks or whole units via the LoadableProvider (Siemens.Engineering.SW.Loader.LoadableProvider.GenerateLoadable, Openness manual 5.11.3.29/5.11.6.13). Requires confirm=true. Pass block_paths OR unit_names — exactly one source; target_option names the TargetOption member (omitted: provider default). The output file is what a loader/firmware flow consumes, not a download to hardware.

block_paths.description: PLC block paths to include; use this OR unit_names.

confirm.description: Mutation confirmation the TIA bridge enforces: the call is refused unless this flag is true.

device_name.description: Exact device (station) name, e.g. from tia_openness_list_devices.

output_path.description: Destination file path for the loadable file.

save_project.description: Persist the project to disk after this mutation. Default false: the change lives only in the running TIA Portal and is LOST if the Portal exits/crashes before a later save. Pass true at milestones (cheap) instead of batching everything to one final save.

target_option.description: TargetOption member name; omitted uses the provider default.

tia_version.description: Target TIA Portal version, V16-V21 (e.g. "V20"; bare "20" also accepted). Omitted: the bridge attaches to the running portal if one is open, else the highest installed version.

unit_names.description: Software unit names to include; use this OR block_paths.

contract.name: tia_openness_generate_loadable_file
